overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, well-targeted academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, information operations, and research tool releases, generating high engagement relative to audience size across all platforms.

contentThemes.description: Updates regarding newly published research papers, grants, and academic milestones.
Product updates and software version releases like CooRnet for detecting coordinated link sharing.
Job announcements for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for prospective PhD students.
Speaking engagements, conference previews, and discussions on computational methods for analyzing disinformation.

recommendations: Cross-post successful media and research announcements consistently, using platform-tailored visual assets or links.
Capitalize on high repost rates on Bluesky by including direct call-to-actions and external links to papers and tools.
Increase posting frequency on professional networks like LinkedIn where grant news and hiring announcements receive significant absolute interaction.
Engage directly in thread replies on Mastodon and Bluesky to foster deeper community discussions around methodological topics.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), driven by strong amplification (reposts) on research paper announcements and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides strong engagement within a niche academic audience (aoir.social instance), particularly interested in software tool releases like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the highest total volume of likes and comments (1850 followers), making it the most effective platform for institutional news, grant announcements, and recruitment.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
